stories.title: The Cruel Warrior's Dragon Trophies
stories.summary: Deliver the three distinct dragon scales and broken lance requested by the warrior. Delivery does not prove personal kills, and this is separate from helping the wounded dragon.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a gold dragon scale
steps.hint: Supplies received from another player are also accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a broken mithral lance
steps.hint: Supplies received from another player are also accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a green-hued gold dragon scale
steps.hint: Supplies received from another player are also accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x the brown-hued scale of an elder gold dragon
steps.hint: Supplies received from another player are also accepted.
Return to the request giver with the exact offering.

stories.title: Help the Wounded Gold Dragon
stories.summary: Deliver the black sword, black platemail, and dark-spirit totem to help the wounded dragon. The journal records the exchange, not personal kills or a locked faction choice.

steps.hint: Supplies received from another player are also accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a full suit of black platemail
steps.hint: Supplies received from another player are also accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x the totem of dark spirits
steps.hint: Supplies received from another player are also accepted.
Return to the request giver with the exact offering.
